Check if there's a printed QR Code of contact number or hotline number visible to the customers:
1. Telemarketer's hotline - for service appointment
2. CRO - for complaints

how_to_source_rows.subject: Blocking of SA for Walk-In customer
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Does Telemarketer perform block time for walk-in customers?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check Appointment List if there is alloted block time for walk in.

how_to_source_rows.subject: SA assignment
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Does Telemarketer assign and inform each SA their assigned customer with their appointment time?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check Appointment List if there is SA allocated for each customer.

how_to_source_rows.subject: Reconfirmation Call
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Does Telemarketer make appointment reconfirmation call the day before?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check Appointment List if with remarks that customers have been contacted for appointment reconfirmation 1 day prior.

how_to_source_rows.subject: Otoleap Booking Management
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: There should be no pending bookings more than 24hrs after it was created (Otoleap)
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check Otoleap calendar for the same month if there are no pending bookings the days prior the day of audit.

how_to_source_rows.subject: Appointment Welcome Board
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item:
Is the Appointment Welcome board visible to customer?

With complete details as follows:
1) today's date
2) time slot
3) name or plate number of customer
4) SA name
5) purpose of visit: e.g. 10K PMS, GR, etc.
6) Arrival Status (Green - On time, Yellow - Late, Red - No Show)
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check if based on standard template, if installed near service entrance, and visible to incoming customers inside their vehicle.

how_to_source_rows.subject: Appointment
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Telemarketer shares the list of customers booked 1 day before the day of appointment to all concerned after-sales personnel (Security Guard, Job Controller, Leadman, Parts Warehouse Staff, Service Advisor, Service Manager, Sales Executive - optional)
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check if all mentioned service personnel have a copy of the Appointment List.

how_to_source_rows.subject: Dedicated Appointment and Walk-In Bay
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Is there dedicated appointment bay and walk in receiving bays?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check if SA/ Car Jockey is aware of the allocation of appointment and walk in receiving bays (minimum of 2 bays).

how_to_source_rows.subject: Customer Relations Department
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Customer Relations Department (CRO, Receptionist, Telemarketer) personnel count must be based on the standard requirements.
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Compute required count and function based on the latest released Standard Bulletin: MMPC SD-2024-010-S - Service CRD Manpower Count Duties  Responsibilities (Dec 2024)

how_to_source_rows.subject: Queuing system
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Is there a queuing system in the reception area?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check:
1. Observe if queuing system is effective and if process is consistently done by concerned service personnel. 
2. Interview 2 customers if they are aware of their queuing number, and if the prioritization system (On time/ early/ late appointment, and walk in customer) was explained by Receptionist/ SA especially if customer needs to wait for the SA's availability

how_to_source_rows.subject: Peak hours
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Is there a Receptionist who will accommodate customer during peak hours or if all SA's are still accomodating the customers?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: During peak hours, check if there is an assigned personnel who can receive customers or can explain prioritization process.

how_to_source_rows.subject: CRM Requirements
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Dedicated digital tablet for walk-around inspection is available. (1 Tablet : 1 SA) (Updated to minimum Google Android ver. 9; Apple iOS 10)
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check if tablet is sufficient (1:1 with SA)

how_to_source_rows.subject: Walk Around Inspection
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Does SA always inspect vehicle for any car body damage using standard walk around inspection checklist?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check 3 samples if walk around inspection is done and the WAI app is used by the SA; check all SA's implementation if possible.

how_to_source_rows.subject: Protective Covers
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item:
Does SA always put the following protective covers before transfering the vehicle to workshop?

1. Steering wheel cover
2. Seat Cover
3. Shifting knob cover
4. Handbrake cover
5. Floormats
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check if all service units in the workbay (esp. ongoing repair) have complete protective covers.

how_to_source_rows.subject: Vehicle Status Tag
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Do all vehicles in the workshop have a vehicle status tag with promised date/ time?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check if all service units in the workbay have vehicle status tag.

how_to_source_rows.subject: Direct Reption
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Is there Direct Reception Process done inside the workshop?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check:
Check if there is allocated:
1) Dedicated bay
2) Customer safety area in case the bay is inside Workshop. If the bay is within reception area, the safety area is optional
3) DR kit is available- (Minimum: Glove, Battery tester, Tire gauge, Torch light)

how_to_source_rows.subject: Workshop Driveway
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Workshop entrance/exit is clear of obstructions at all times and not used as parking slots
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Observe service entrance if there is a parked unit for more than 20 minutes

how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Does SA provide the customer a promised time of delivery by checking availability of technician through job controller/ Job Progress Monitoring file?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Observe if SA gives promised time by using the shared Job Progress Monitoring/ Job Plan (updated) as reference, and not just based on flat rate time.

how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check if SA uses any tool (e.g. notebook, notepad, excel, etc.) to ensure that all their received customers will be given update and that they can monitor nearing promised time per customer.

how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: All check items in the subform must be "YES" to count this item compliant.

Service Personnel/Service Advisor/ CRO/ SA on Duty verbally offers all available lounge amenities to customers (WiFi access/ password, Sofa, TV, CR)
1) complimentary drink and snack 
2) WIFI, Password

how_to_source_rows.how_to_check:

how_to_source_rows.subject: Shuttle Service Assistance
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Does the SA offer shuttle service transportation or assistance (e.g. grab, taxi etc…)?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check if there is poster and check by observing SA during RO processing and explanation with customer

150K > offer new vehicle

how_to_source_rows.subject: Job Progress Monitoring

how_to_source_rows.how_to_check:
Check the Job Progress Monitoring toolkit (excel/ board):
- Check in the morning if all appointment customers are included in the job plan for the day
- Check if walk-in customers are also monitored for proper allocation per bay and technician
- Check if actual progress per unit is recorded in the toolkit

how_to_source_rows.subject: Carwash Control Board

how_to_source_rows.subject: Job Progress Monitoring
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item: Did Job Controller make car wash plan and communicate with carwasher the promised time of received customers?
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check:
1. Check Job Progress Monitoring/ Job Plan if with car wash plan
2. Check if uses 2-way radio (Job Controller and Car washer)

how_to_source_rows.subject: Technicians Clock-In

how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check if there is a tool that is used to clock in and out Technician's repair time (that is being used by Service Manager to monitor productivity, utilization and efficiency)

how_to_source_rows.subject: Repair

how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check monitoring tool used by the Parts Staff for emergency orders.

how_to_source_rows.subject: MAM
how_to_source_rows.checklist_item:
Are the following KPI being monitored and ready to be discussed in case its necessary during "Weekly Meeting"?: 

MAIN KPI:
1) Actual SIU and target agreed with MMPC
2) Actual first retention rate
3) Actual P&A booking and target agreed with MMPC
4) Stock month of fast moving parts
5) Appointment ratio
6) Dead stock ratio 
7) CSI

Technician Report:
8) Efficiency (labor sold hr / actual worked hr)
9) Utilization (actual worked hr / available hr)
10) Productivity (efficiency x utilization)

CRO/ Telemarketer:
11) Reminder call coverage ratio (actual reminder call / target reminder call)
12) Proactive call acceptance ratio (actual accepted appointment booking / called customer)
13) Follow up call ratio
14) Customer Complaint Tracking Discussion (Red alert, critical concerns)
15) Appointment balance for a day (Morning = 80%, Afternoon = 20%)

Job Controller: 
16) On time delivery and on time arrival ratio (from service time monitoring)

Others:
17) Fix it right first time or repeat repair ratio (F1)
18) Direct reception (optional)
19) Focus item upselling (optional)
how_to_source_rows.how_to_check: Check minutes of the meeting (quality)
